scope: RL stage 4 evidence for the first PPO push checkpoint (20261030T173207, iteration 99): held-out box mass/friction (new seed, same ranges) against the scripted command on the same starts, with per-environment command and hand-push statistics and monitor-only stall scoring; plus five showcase boxes (4.9-29.4 N slide force) recorded at 10 fps with per-decision traces, where a stall stops the push policy and GR00T Balance holds the robot for 2 s. Stall thresholds (1.5 s window, >= 15 N mean hand push, < 2 cm box progress) were calibrated on run 20261030T180114 showcase traces.
